text: どうしよう　また　おなか　すいちゃった…

structure.jp: おなか　すいちゃった…

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing ended up happening, often to your regret. ちゃった is its casual short form. すいちゃった = 'I've gone and gotten hungry'.

patterns.name: 〜よう
patterns.explanation: The よう ending with a question word asks yourself what to do. どうしよう = 'what shall I do?'
